# Anvil

Anvil is Ditto's React design system. It contains the shared components,
themes, tokens, and fonts used across Ditto web applications.

## Use the package

Install Anvil with React, React DOM, and Tailwind CSS:

```sh
yarn add @dittolive/anvil react react-dom tailwindcss
```

Import Tailwind and Anvil's theme from your application stylesheet:

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@dittolive/anvil/theme.css';

@source './src';
```

Then import components from the package:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@dittolive/anvil'

export const SaveButton = () => <Button>Save</Button>
```

## Browse components

Use the navigation to see each component's API, states, and interactive
examples. The theme control in the toolbar previews system, light, dark, and
high-contrast themes.
